INSTITUTIONAL BUYERS

Procurement-ready
information.

Start with the institution, opportunity and qualification checklist. Vendor status and supporting documents are confirmed against the specific procurement channel before they are represented as current.

REGISTRATION & ELIGIBILITY

Specific to the opportunity.

Roster, framework and tender eligibility can differ by institution, role and assignment. This website does not imply active registration or pre-qualification in any particular system. Share the institution and reference number and I will confirm the relevant status before making a representation.

WHAT TO INCLUDE
  • Institution, framework or procurement channel
  • Solicitation / notice number and deadline
  • Required CV format and qualification checklist
  • Any document handling or confidentiality instructions

Please do not attach restricted tender or personal documents to the website. Agree a suitable transfer method first; this site has no upload or document-storage service.

FOUR BUYER LENSES

Different roles.
Different proof.

Use the route that matches the question you are evaluating. Each path leads to evidence or an enquiry with a defined purpose.

01 / PROCUREMENT / VENDOR MANAGEMENT

When this is relevant

A roster update, framework call or tender needs a qualified individual or team.

What helps the evaluation

Opportunity-specific eligibility, current CV format, references with permission, and any required compliance or financial records.

Request vendor information↗
02 / TASK-TEAM LEADER

When this is relevant

An appraisal, costing, financing or policy question is holding up a decision.

What helps the evaluation

Relevant assignment scope, analytical contribution, method and limitations stated clearly.

Review selected assignments↗
03 / COUNTRY OR PROGRAMME DIRECTOR

When this is relevant

A programme needs a credible route from evidence to financing and delivery.

What helps the evaluation

A decision-led scope, implementation assumptions, risks and practical handover.

Explore strategy & delivery↗
04 / UNIVERSITY PRINCIPAL INVESTIGATOR

When this is relevant

A research partnership needs economic analysis, field evidence or a policy-facing synthesis.

What helps the evaluation

Research design, methods, attributed contribution and a defensible evidence trail.

DOCUMENTS & REFERENCES

Confirm each item
before sharing.

A procurement request may ask for an institutional CV, relevant past-performance references, business or tax details, compliance declarations, insurance or financial information. The exact documents, date, permissions and sharing conditions must be checked for that opportunity.

Nothing on this page claims that a registration, certificate, insurance policy or framework status is active. Where a document is unavailable, restricted or not applicable, that should be stated plainly rather than implied.

For the consulting offer and its current scope, see ProposalDesk. For how quality checks and risk boundaries are handled, read Quality & risk management.
